description: On the table in front of you are a banana, a slice of bread, a donut, a metal baking tray, a red plate with a croissant, and a hamburger off to the right. The left hand reaches forward toward the red plate, grasps the croissant as a left-hand object, lifts it up and carries it leftward to the metal tray, then lowers and releases it onto the tray while the right hand stays mostly still and empty.
